sealed._rules: Sealed with session-vectors.json's epoch-0 key and ck key, direction 0 = desktop to phone, 1 = phone to desktop, counters from 900 (no other file uses them). aad is from|to|class. prefs travels class pair (the phone's CB-358 frame); caps class state ck Ck('caps'); windows class chat ck Ck(session_id); everything else class action, ck empty on a phone request and Ck(session_id) on a desk reply. The envelope carries no field this file adds: class, push and ck are frames-v4's.
